herbs.name: Fenugreek
herbs.benefit: May support post-meal glucose control when used as food adjunct.
herbs.research_summary: Small clinical studies suggest fenugreek fiber may modestly reduce fasting and postprandial glucose, but dosing and preparation vary.

herbs.name: Bitter gourd
herbs.benefit: May have mild glucose-lowering effect as part of meals.
herbs.research_summary: Biomedical literature describes insulin-like compounds, but human trial evidence is mixed and should not replace medication.

herbs.name: Amla
herbs.benefit: Antioxidant-rich fruit that may support cardiometabolic health.
herbs.research_summary: Early studies report possible lipid and glucose benefits, with limited high-quality diabetes-specific outcome evidence.

lifestyle_changes.name: Walking
lifestyle_changes.recommendation: 150 minutes/week of brisk walking plus two resistance sessions

lifestyle_changes.name: Yoga
lifestyle_changes.recommendation: 20-30 minutes/day of supervised yoga or breathing practice as an adjunct

lifestyle_changes.name: Sleep regularity
lifestyle_changes.recommendation: Target 7-8 hours with consistent sleep and wake times
